judgment_text:
Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying to issue a writ of certiorarified Mandamus calling for the records relating to form-III in Notice No. 960/P.A./FILE-11/dated 29-7-2024 of the 4th respondent and quash the same and consequently direct the respondents to follow the directions issued by this Honourable Court in T.S. Senthilkumar v. Government of Tamil Nadu, (2010) 3 Mad LJ 771 for the proceedings under Tamil Nadu Protection of Tanks and Eviction of Encroachment Act, 2007

The Order of the Court was delivered by

S.M. Subramaniam, J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this Writ Petition and she had also made an endorsement to that effect.

2. In view of the submission and endorsement made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, this Writ Petition is dismissed as withdrawn. No costs. Consequently, the connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
